Dynamic evidence shows target imports from production repo code resolved to site-packages/treq, with no source imports from production repo code and no local target provider detected.
evidence: coinbaseadvanced/client.py adds import treq and calls treq.request(...) plus treq.content(response).
coinbaseadvanced/client.py removes import requests and routes HTTP methods through _TreqRequestsCompat backed by treq.
coinbaseadvanced/models/*.py remove requests imports and change requests.Response annotations to Any.

reasons: Production code imports and calls treq APIs.
Changed production files do not import requests directly or dynamically.
No local fake treq provider or target shim is indicated.

+_REACTOR_READY = threading.Event()
+_REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED = False
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor_running() -> None:
+    global _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED
+
+    if reactor.running:
+        _REACTOR_READY.set()
+        return
+
+    if not _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED:
+        _REACTOR_THREAD_STARTED = True
+
+        def _run_reactor() -> None:
+            reactor.callWhenRunning(_REACTOR_READY.set)
+            reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)
+
+        threading.Thread(
+            target=_run_reactor,
+            name="coinbaseadvanced-twisted-reactor",
+            daemon=True,
+        ).start()
+
+    _REACTOR_READY.wait()
+
+
+class _SyncResponse:
+    def __init__(self, code: int, body: bytes) -> None:
+        self.status_code = code
+        self.ok = 200 <= code < 400
+        self.text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self.text)
+
+
+class _TreqRequestsCompat:
+    def get(self, url, headers=None, timeout=None):
+        return self._request("GET", url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
+
+    def post(self, url, json=None, headers=None, timeout=None):
+        return self._request("POST", url, headers=headers, payload=json, timeout=timeout)
+
+    def put(self, url, json=None, headers=None, timeout=None):
+        return self._request("PUT", url, headers=headers, payload=json, timeout=timeout)
+
+    def delete(self, url, json=None, headers=None, timeout=None):
+        return self._request("DELETE", url, headers=headers, payload=json, timeout=timeout)
+
+    def _request(self, method: str, url: str, headers=None, payload=None, timeout=None):
+        _ensure_reactor_running()
+        return threads.blockingCallFromThread(
+            reactor,
+            self._request_deferred,
+            method,
+            url,
+            headers,
+            payload,
+            timeout,
+        )
+
+    @defer.inlineCallbacks
+    def _request_deferred(self, method: str, url: str, headers=None, payload=None, timeout=None):
+        request_headers = dict(headers or {})
+        body = None
+
+        if payload is not None:
+            request_headers.setdefault("Content-Type", "application/json")
+            body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+
+        response = yield treq.request(
+            method,
+            url,
+            headers=request_headers,
+            data=body,
+            timeout=timeout,
+        )
+        content = yield treq.content(response)
+        return _SyncResponse(response.code, content)
+
+
+_requests_compat = _TreqRequestsCompat()
+requests = _requests_compat
